name: – Giuseppe Lupo – Motion for a resolution
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Union Solidarity Fund to provide assistance to Germany and Italy relating to floods occurred in 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving money from the European Union Solidarity Fund to Germany and Italy after floods in 2024. Germany gets about 112 million euros for floods in the south in May and June. Italy gets about 4 million euros for floods in the Valle d'Aosta region in June. The report also asks the European Union to spend more on preparing for and limiting climate change, and to make the fund bigger so it can help faster.

- Germany receives 112,071,681 euros and Italy 3,959,872 euros in flood aid.
- The money helps people and regions in southern Germany and Valle d'Aosta, Italy.
- Parliament leaders sign the decision, then it is published and takes effect.
